name: AWS CloudTrail - S3 Bucket Changes

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail  (*Bucket*)
| parse "\"eventSource\":\"*\"" as event_source | where event_source="s3.amazonaws.com"
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name 
| where event_name in ("PutBucketAcl","PutBucketPolicy","PutBucketCors","PutBucketLifecycle","PutBucketReplication","DeleteBucketPolicy","DeleteBucketCors","DeleteBucketLifecycle","DeleteBucketReplication")
// EOQ

description: Monitor for changes to S3 bucket configuration.
